text_block_list.text:
Dang, the Oka Sho was no joke.
Everyone gave
me a real run for my
money.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Not bad for our first taste of the Tiara
tour. Heh,
things are looking good!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Oaks won't be a walk in
the park
either, though. Let's keep up
the heat, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We hop on the train home, only to spot
an ad for
the Satsuki Sho featuring none
other than Narita
Brian.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That reminds me—the Satsuki Sho is
happening
next week.  I heard through
the grapevine that
Brian's a step above
the rest.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I wonder what she's got up her sleeve.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I bet she's gotten crazy strong. Way
better than
she was before...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right, I know what's going on my
plate tonight!
I'm boilin' up a
protein-packed hot pot for those
muscle
gains!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Let's swing by the shopping district on
the way
back, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
After our detour, Хиши Амадзон returns
to the
dorm carrying two grocery bags
full of chicken.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Oaks around the
corner, she's
raring to go!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
